!!!
H-he grabbed me by the arm! 
???: Wait boy… Do you come here frequently?
You: N-not at all, i-it’s my first t-t-time here…
???: First time, huh?
???: Let me take a closer look at ya.
As he said it he pulled out a flashlight from his pocket!
I can’t let him see my face or I might end up like Shanice!
